bounds.domain: One immutable organization-credit quote, two competing settlement callers, two customer identities, one original Session and PaymentIntent, one conflicting prior ledger intent, credit value 2, six clock values and a three-tick original dispatch window. Fresh quotes, historical ambiguous rows with missing first-dispatch evidence, and failed historical rows have separate initial states.
bounds.assumptions: Paid/matching is an equivalence class of every immutable receipt check. The provider preserves its request-key contract inside the supported retry window. The primary transaction atomically publishes the order and credit ledger, and uniqueness failure rolls it back. PostgreSQL/PGlite tests independently exercise actual SQL constraints and selected route/service schedules.
bounds.limitations: This component does not establish full checkout refinement. Legacy custom-amount settlement and pack quarantine, arbitrary monetary values, complete provider pagination, pre-provider membership/role withdrawal, multiple orders, refunds/reversals, external request delivery delay and live Stripe behavior require separate composition. No liveness claim: provider, storage or cache can remain unavailable.
